allowed_provisional_claim: SABLE-MO is explicitly designed and prospectively characterized for extreme-small-sample same-patient multi-omics representation learning using block-balanced optimization, shared/private decomposition, missing-view recovery, and factor-and-subspace reproducibility gates.
final_first_or_unique_claim_rule: No first or unique claim is permitted until a documented systematic novelty search is repeated immediately before manuscript submission.
forbidden_claims: existing methods were never evaluated below n=100
headline_novelty_components: outcome-blind model selection before biological annotation

related_work_distinctions.CODE_AE: shared/private domain separation between cell lines and patient tissues for drug-response transfer, not same-patient omics views
related_work_distinctions.Flexynesis: modular bulk multi-omics deep-learning toolkit; not the same prospective factor acceptance and rejection framework
related_work_distinctions.MOFA_plus: probabilistic shared and view-specific factors with native missing-value handling and ARD/sparsity
related_work_distinctions.stability_based_multiomics: stability concepts pre-exist; novelty cannot rest on stability alone
